alt: iPhone Settings app showing a persistent promotional banner with a red notification badge pushing iCloud+ subscription upgrades
story: Apple began embedding persistent promotional banners in the iPhone Settings app in iOS that cannot be dismissed, with a red notification badge making sales pitches for iCloud+ indistinguishable from urgent security warnings — even for users already subscribed.
why_funny: Apple built its brand on mocking Google's ad-driven model, then added undismissable ads disguised as security alerts to the most 'trusted' screen on its own phone.
